rootCause: The optional legacy region gate extracts domain-shaped strings from arbitrary tool text. Actual denied calls contained json.load, json.tool, sys.executable and Docker .Config.Entrypoint, plus ordinary GitHub metadata/source requests. The personal.14 partial fix did not resolve this general classification error.
change: Dedicated personal VM original capability composition skips region registration unless config.legacyRegionGate is boolean true. Other original hooks are retained.
unchanged: Managed review tool restrictions, project scope and evidence checks
Original prompts and other original capability hooks
Frozen precheck candidate, scanning contracts and scoring thresholds
limits: Disabling this heuristic does not grant authorization for unrelated external targets.
Model provider policies, tool availability, network failures and managed scope guards can still reject work.
This change is not a network sandbox or an R3 acceptance result.

diagnosticAttempts.cause: The native validation helper created a QA agent without selecting the standard preset; the added local execution returned UNKNOWN_TOOL for bash. The helper was corrected to select standard and assert that all required native tools exist. The tested production candidate did not change.
